trap.label: would × used to (produção)
trap.wrong: I would be tired at five, and my boss would pay us in cash.
trap.right: I used to be tired at five, and my boss used to pay us in cash.
trap.why: Em português o imperfeito serve para tudo. Em inglês, would só em ação repetida; para estado e situação permanente, use used to.

mcq.q: My boss ___ pay us in cash.

opts: I used to own a car.

fix.wrong: We would have an old car.
fix.right: We used to have an old car.

fix.wrong: I would to wake up early.

fix.right: She used to be a nurse.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com would: “I woke up at five every day.”
rewrite.answer: I would wake up at five every day.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com used to: “My boss paid us in cash.”
rewrite.answer: My boss used to pay us in cash.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva negativa: “I would wake up late.”
